verdict.rationale: Vercel Agent is documented as an AI assistant built into Vercel, available in dashboard chat, Slack, Investigations and Code Review. It draws on your projects, deployments, logs, metrics, configuration and usage to explain projects, investigate production issues and propose suggested changes, which directly matches in-product AI insights from your data. Missing for 10: features are only in public beta and limited to Pro/Enterprise teams; no detail on proactive or unprompted insight surfacing; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
